sections.title: Improvements
items: HR list warnings and Monday emails now use shared thresholds.
The HR recipient search suggests matching accounts while typing.

sections.title: New features
items: HR can review changes to assigned employee time entries and work settings, including previous and new values.

sections.title: Improvements
items: HR changes are kept for twelve months; deleted accounts are removed or anonymised.

sections.title: Bug fixes
items: Access checks for employee entries and work settings follow HR responsibility.

sections.title: New features
items: HR responsibility can be assigned to groups and individual accounts.
HR email recipients can be selected separately for each rule.

sections.title: New features
items: Employees and HR receive reminders for individual missing or incomplete time entries.
HR can filter employees by activity or freelancer status and search by name.
Employees have a guided tour and email links for contacting HR.
Update notes are available in the app and the notification bell.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Break display preferences are saved for each account.
HR manages group assignments and time rules in personal settings.

sections.title: Bug fixes
items: The formal German interface and removal icons display correctly.
